# WoWEverywhere 1.0.0

- **New name: WoWEverywhere.** WoW AndroWhere is now called WoWEverywhere, in the app, the launcher and the download. It updates in place and keeps your profiles, servers, saved logins, game files and addons.
- **Simpler Server screen.** Pressing A on a server, or tapping it, now just selects it. Y, or the pencil on the right, opens it to edit, and Remove server is inside with a confirmation. Add server asks what you're adding: an online server, your own server on this device, or your own server on a PC.
- **One Private server choice for new profiles.** Choose your client folder and the app reads the version from Wow.exe (1.12.1, 2.4.3, 3.3.5a, 4.3.4 or 5.4.8) and sets the profile up for it.
- **Choose the game's resolution.** Settings, App has Automatic, 720p, 900p, 1080p and Native, for every profile, private servers included.
- **Choose your Battle.net region.** Pick Americas, Europe, Korea or Taiwan when you install, or in Settings, Battle.net.
- **WoW Forever signs in on a first start.** The Screen Narrator question no longer blocks the saved login, and the login waits up to ten minutes for a slow first start.

## Install

Download **WoWEverywhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.9.3 and keeps your settings, saved logins, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
